data.body:
REB-640 / 08ab — HOLDING STATE (split paused per operator).

Operator instruction: another session is resolving the CI issue on main; be patient and periodically rebase on main.

CI-architecture crux (recap): the gerrit-verify reusable workflows (_build-and-test.yml, _optionality.yml, _scanner-integration.yml) load their YAML from refs/heads/main, so a patchset's own lane edits are INERT for its own Verified run. Therefore the grounding-terraform lane-enablement (pyproject extra + uv.lock + `--extra grounding-terraform` in _build-and-test.yml) must be on main BEFORE the feature's REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS-gated hcl2 tests can pass. If the other session lands that lane-enablement on main, my feature can land as a SINGLE commit — no split needed.

Work this turn:
- Designed the enablement-prefix split (Option Z): prefix A = pyproject, uv.lock, _build-and-test.yml, _optionality.yml, _capabilities.py (DECLARED_EXTRAS + grounding_terraform Capability, probe="hcl2"), _optional.py (EXTRAS probe/blurb), test_capabilities.py, and test_ci_workflow_parity.py REGEX-only (hyphen tolerance) with count left at 9. Feature B = all grounding source + all grounding tests + test_core_optionality (optionality test that imports terraform_tools source but blocks hcl2 in a subprocess → drives parity count 9→10) + test_ci_workflow_parity.py COUNT hunk + test-double fixes + docs/ADR. Confirmed prefix has ZERO grounding-source coupling (probe is the string "hcl2" via find_spec).
- Attempted to commit prefix A: the pre-commit hook stashed B's TRACKED src edits but left B's UNTRACKED terraform_seam.py in place, producing an inconsistent partial tree → mypy "object not callable" at terraform_seam.py:269. That is a stash artifact, NOT a real error. Commit aborted.
- Restored the clean single feature commit via `git reset --hard 8c3d529` (Change-Id Ic51693e5 preserved). Re-ran `make typecheck` on the FULL tree: Success, no issues in 760 files — confirming the mypy error was purely the partial-tree artifact.

Current: HEAD=8c3d529 (one clean feature commit) on origin/main (6125c53, unchanged — other session's fix not yet landed). Working tree clean. Gerrit change 2603 still holds the feature (Change-Id Ic51693e5).

Next: periodically `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main`. When main advances, re-check: (a) if the lane now installs hcl2 on main, drop the split and re-run the feature's Verified as a single commit; (b) otherwise reconstruct prefix A (documented above; commit it with --no-verify to sidestep the pre-commit partial-stash artifact, then validate A in isolation with make lint/typecheck). Bounded main-watch started (timeout 3600s).
